units: <cite ref="Ketubot 112b:2">Keth. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ אחר צ׳</he> one reduction after the other (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 6:13">Is. VI, 13</cite>).

senses.gloss: fusion, the state of being considered as one coherent mass or as one act.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 19a:8">Pes. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ דאורייתא</he> that things contained in one vessel are to be considered as one mass is a Biblical rule.

<cite ref="Nazir 4a:6">Naz. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>ר״ש לית ליה צ׳</he> R. S. does not adopt the rule of fusion (that the various things forbidden to the Nazarite, if partaken of together, combine to make up the legal quantity).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:2:6">Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ</cite> <he>למה לי צ׳</he> why is it necessary to apply the rule of fusion?; <he>ואם צ׳ וכ׳</he> and if you apply the rule of fusion &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צֵירוּפִין</he>. Y. Naz. II, 54ᶜ bot. [read:] <he>ולמה נכללו לצ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>לצירוכין</he>, corr. acc.) and why have they again been stated by implication? To intimate that the rule of fusion applies to them (if eaten together). Ib.ᵈ bot. <he>בצֵירוּפֵי נזיר</he> as to the rule of fusion applied to the Nazarite; a. e.
